\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        q = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us\").read_text())\n        p = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us\").read_text())\n        if q > 0:\n            return math.ceil(q / p)\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return os.cpu_count() or 1\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nimport psutil\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or psutil.virtual_memory().total / 1e9\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = min(psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9, TOTAL_RAM_GB)\nlogger.info(f\"Hardware: {NUM_CPUS} CPUs, {TOTAL_RAM_GB:.1f} GB RAM\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Resource limits \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 0.7 * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\nlogger.info(f\"Memory limit: {RAM_BUDGET / 1e9:.1f} GB\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Phoneme estimation (language-specific ratios) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n# Average phonemes per character for different language families\nPHONEME_RATIO = {\n    # Indo-European (Latin script)\n    \"eng\": 1.2, \"deu\": 1.1, \"fra\": 1.3, \"spa\": 1.1, \"ita\": 1.1,\n    \"nld\": 1.1, \"pol\": 1.2, \"ron\": 1.1, \"swe\": 1.1, \"dan\": 1.1,\n    \"nor\": 1.1, \"ces\": 1.1, \"slk\": 1.1, \"slv\": 1.1, \"hrv\": 1.1,\n    # Indo-European (Cyrillic)\n    \"rus\": 0.8, \"ukr\": 0.8, \"bul\": 0.8, \"srp\": 0.8,\n    # Uralic\n    \"fin\": 1.0, \"hun\": 1.0, \"est\": 1.0,\n    # Turkic\n    \"tur\": 1.0, \"kaz\": 0.9, \"uzb\": 0.9,\n    # Afroasiatic\n    \"ara\": 0.9, \"heb\": 0.8, \"amh\": 0.7, \"hau\": 1.0,\n    # Indo-Aryan\n    \"hin\": 0.6, \"mar\": 0.6,\n    # Sino-Tibetan\n    \"zho\": 1.0, \"mya\": 0.9, \"tam\": 0.8,\n    # Austronesian\n    \"tgl\": 1.1, \"jav\": 1.0, \"ind\": 1.0, \"msa\": 1.0,\n    # Japonic/Koreanic\n    \"jpn\": 0.7, \"kor\": 0.6,\n    # Austroasiatic\n    \"vie\": 0.9,\n    # Kartvelian\n    \"kat\": 1.0,\n}\n\n# Characters that don't count as phonemes (punctuation, whitespace)\nNON_PHONEME_CHARS = set(' .,;:!?()[]{}\"\"\\'-/\\\\|@#$%^&*+=<>~`')\n\n\ndef estimate_phoneme_count(word: str, lang_code: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Estimate phoneme count for a word using language-specific ratio.\"\"\"\n    # Clean the word\n    clean = ''.join(c for c in word if c not in NON_PHONEME_CHARS)\n    if not clean:\n        return 0\n    \n    ratio = PHONEME_RATIO.get(lang_code, 1.0)\n    # For CJK, use character count directly (each character \u2248 1 syllable)\n    if any('\\u4e00' <= c <= '\\u9fff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\u3040' <= c <= '\\u309f' or '\\u30a0' <= c <= '\\u30ff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\uac00' <= c <= '\\ud7a3' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean) // 3  # Korean syllables\n    \n    return max(1, int(len(clean) * ratio))\n\n\ndef get_language_code(config_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Extract language code from config_id.\"\"\"\n    return config_id.split('_')[0]\n\n\ndef compute_pid_for_sentence(\n    tokens: list[str],\n    heads: list[int],\n    lang_code: str\n) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:\n    \"\"\"Compute Phoneme-Interval Distance for each dependency arc.\n    \n    PID = total number of phonemes strictly between head and dependent.\n    \n    Returns:\n        (pid_values, word_distances)\n    \"\"\"\n    pid_values = []\n    word_distances = []\n    \n    # Estimate phoneme counts for all tokens\n    phoneme_counts = [estimate_phoneme_count(t, lang_code) for t in tokens]\n    \n    for j, h in enumerate(heads):\n        if h == 0:  # Skip root\n            continue\n        \n        head_pos = h - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed\n        dep_pos = j\n        \n        # Word distance\n        word_dist = abs(head_pos - dep_pos)\n        word_distances.append(word_dist)\n        \n        # PID: sum of phoneme counts strictly between head and dependent\n        min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        \n        pid = sum(phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos + 1, max_pos))\n        pid_values.append(pid)\n    \n    return pid_values, word_distances\n\n\ndef process_language(config_id: str, max_sentences: int = 200) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Process a single language: load data, compute PIDs.\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"config_id\": config_id,\n        \"success\": False,\n        \"n_sentences\": 0,\n        \"n_dependencies\": 0,\n        \"mean_pid\": None,\n        \"median_pid\": None,\n        \"std_pid\": None,\n        \"max_pid\": None,\n        \"mean_word_distance\": None,\n        \"median_word_distance\": None,\n    }\n    \n    try:\n        from datasets import load_dataset\n        \n        ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", config_id, split=\"train\", streaming=True)\n        \n        lang_code = get_language_code(config_id)\n        all_pids = []\n        all_word_dists = []\n        \n        sentence_count = 0\n        for row in ds:\n            if sentence_count >= max_sentences:\n                break\n            \n            tokens = row.get(\"tokens\", [])\n            head = row.get(\"head\", [])\n            \n            if not tokens or not head:\n                continue\n            \n            # Parse heads\n            try:\n                head_list = [int(h) for h in str(head).strip(\"[]\").split(\",\") if h.strip()]\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            \n            # Trim to match tokens\n            n_tokens = min(len(tokens), len(head_list))\n            if n_tokens == 0:\n                continue\n            \n            tokens = tokens[:n_tokens]\n            head_list = head_list[:n_tokens]\n            \n            # Compute PIDs\n            pids, word_dists = compute_pid_for_sentence(tokens, head_list, lang_code)\n            \n            all_pids.extend(pids)\n            all_word_dists.extend(word_dists)\n            \n            sentence_count += 1\n        \n        if not all_pids:\n            logger.warning(f\"No dependencies for {config_id}\")\n            return result\n        \n        result[\"success\"] = True\n        result[\"n_sentences\"] = sentence_count\n        result[\"n_dependencies\"] = len(all_pids)\n        result[\"mean_pid\"] = float(np.mean(all_pids))\n        result[\"median_pid\"] = float(np.median(all_pids))\n        result[\"std_pid\"] = float(np.std(all_pids))\n        result[\"max_pid\"] = int(max(all_pids))\n        result[\"mean_word_distance\"] = float(np.mean(all_word_dists))\n        result[\"median_word_distance\"] = float(np.median(all_word_dists))\n        \n        # Cache for potential re-analysis\n        result[\"_pids\"] = all_pids\n        result[\"_word_dists\"] = all_word_dists\n        \n        logger.info(f\"\u2713 {config_id}: {sentence_count} sentences, {len(all_pids)} deps, mean_pid={result['mean_pid']:.2f}\")\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.error(f\"Failed {config_id}: {e}\")\n    \n    return result\n\n\ndef create_figures(results: list[dict], language_metadata: dict) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Generate visualization figures.\"\"\"\n    figures = []\n    output_dir = Path(\"figures\")\n    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Filter successful results\n    valid = [r for r in results if r[\"success\"]]\n    if len(valid) < 5:\n        logger.warning(\"Insufficient data for figures\")\n        return figures\n    \n    lang_names = [r[\"config_id\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_pids = [r[\"mean_pid\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_word_dists = [r[\"mean_word_distance\"] for r in valid]\n    families = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"word_order\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    phon_density = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"phonological_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    n_sents = [r[\"n_sentences\"] for r in valid]\n    \n    # Color map for families\n    family_colors = sns.color_palette(\"husl\", max(1, len(set(families))))\n    family_to_color = dict(zip(sorted(set(families)), family_colors))\n    \n    # Figure 1: Phonological density vs mean PID\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    for i, (pd_val, pid_val, family, size) in enumerate(zip(phon_density, mean_pids, families, n_sents)):\n        color = p(x_range), \"r--\", alpha=0.5, \n                label=f\"r = {np.corrcoef(phon_density, mean_pids)[0,1]:.3f}\")\n    \n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Phonological Density (phonemes/syllable)\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean Phoneme-Interval Distance\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_title(\"Phonological Density vs Dependency Distance in Phoneme-Space\", fontsize=14)\n    ax.legend()\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig1_density_vs_pid.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig1_density_vs_pid.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 2: Phonological density vs mean word distance (baseline)\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    for i, (pd_val, wd_val, family) in enumerate(zip(phon_density, mean_word_dists, families)):\n        color = family_to_color.get(family, \"gray\")\n        ax.scatter(pd_val, wd_val, c=color, s=50, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)\n    \n    if len(phon_density) > 5:\n        z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_word_dists, 1)\n        p = {np.corrcoef(phon_density, mean_word_dists)[0,1]:.3f}\")\n    \n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Phonological Density\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean Word Distance (baseline)\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_title(\"Phonological Density vs Word-Space Dependency Distance\", fontsize=14)\n    ax.legend()\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig2_density_vs_word_distance.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig2_density_vs_word_distance.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 3: PID distribution by word order\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n    for idx, wo in enumerate([\"SVO\", \"SOV\"]):\n        mask = [w == wo for w in word_orders]\n        if sum(mask) > 0:\n            data = [mean_pids[i] for i, m in enumerate(mask) if m]\n            axes[idx].boxplot(data, labels=[wo])\n            axes[idx].set_title(f\"PID Distribution ({wo})\", fontsize=12)\n            axes[idx].set_ylabel(\"Mean PID\")\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig3_pid_by_word_order.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig3_pid_by_word_order.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 4: Mean PID by family\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))\n    family_means = {}\n    for f, pid in zip(families, mean_pids):\n        family_means.setdefault(f, []).append(pid)\n    family_avg = {f: np.mean(pids) for f, pids in family_means.items()}\n    bars = ax.bar(range(len(family_avg)), list(family_avg.values()),\n                  color=[family_to_color.get(f, \"gray\") for f in family_avg.keys()])\n    ax.set_xticks(range(len(family_avg)))\n    ax.set_xticklabels(family_avg.keys(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean PID\")\n    ax.set_title(\"Mean Phoneme-Interval Distance by Language Family\", fontsize=14)\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig4_pid_by_family.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig4_pid_by_family.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 5: Rank-rank plot\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    word_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_word_dists)) + 1\n    pid_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_pids)) + 1\n    ax.scatter(word_ranks, pid_ranks, s=50, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')\n    max_rank = max(max(word_ranks), max(pid_ranks))\n    ax.plot([1, max_rank], [1, max_rank], \"r--\", alpha=0.5, label=\"Identity\")\n    corr_r, _ = spearmanr(word_ranks, pid_ranks)\n figures\n\n\ndef run_analysis(results: list[dict], language_metadata: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Run statistical analysis.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if r[\"success\"]]\n    if len(valid) < 10:\n        return {\"error\": \"Insufficient data\"}\n    \n    phon_density = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"phonological_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    mean_pids = [r[\"mean_pid\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_word_dists = [r[\"mean_word_distance\"] for r in valid]\n    \n    # Correlations\n    corr_pid, p_pid = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_pids)\n    corr_wd, p_wd = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_word_dists)\n    \n    # Regression\n    phon_density_arr = np.array(phon_density)\n    mean_pids_arr = np.array(mean_pids)\n    \n    # Simple linear regression\n    z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_pids, 1)\n    predictions = np.poly1d(z)(phon_density_arr)\n    ss_res = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - predictions) ** 2)\n    ss_tot = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - np.mean(mean_pids_arr)) ** 2)\n    r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot) if ss_tot > 0 else 0\n    \n    # Rank correlation\n    word_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_word_dists)) + 1\n    pid_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_pids)) + 1\n    rank_corr, rank_p = spearmanr(word_ranks, pid_ranks)\n    \n    return {\n        \"spearman_correlation_phoneme_space\": {\n            \"r\": float(corr_pid),\n            \"p_value\": float(p_pid),\n            \"n\": len(valid)\n        },\n        \"spearman_correlation_baseline\": {\n            \"r\": float(corr_wd),\n            \"p_value\": float(p_wd),\n            \"n\": len(valid)\n        },\n        \"regression\": {\n            \"r_squared\": float(r_squared),\n            \"slope\": float(z[0]),\n            \"intercept\": float(z[1]),\n        },\n        \"rank_correlation\": {\n            \"r\": float(rank_corr),\n            \"p_value\": float(rank_p),\n        }\n    }\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main experiment pipeline.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.time()\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 1: Load data metadata \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 1: Loading data metadata\")\n    data_path = Path(\"/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_nBwvdB3PKEF8/3_invention_loop/iter_1/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1/full_data_out.json\")\n    \n    with open(data_path) as f:\n        data = json.load(f)\n    \n    # Build language metadata dictionary\n    language_metadata = {}\n    for ds in data[\"datasets\"]:\n        if ds.get(\"examples\"):\n            ex = ds[\"examples\"][0]\n            cfg = ex.get(\"metadata_config_id\", \"\")\n            language_metadata[cfg] = {\n                \"language_name\": ex.get(\"metadata_language\", \"\"),\n                \"family\": ex.get(\"metadata_family\", \"\"),\n                \"word_order\": ex.get(\"metadata_word_order\", \"\"),\n                \"register\": ex.get(\"metadata_register\", \"\"),\n                \"phonological_density\": ex.get(\"metadata_phonological_density\", 0),\n                \"phoneme_count\": ex.get(\"metadata_phoneme_count\", 0),\n            }\n    \n    config_ids = list(language_metadata.keys())\n    logger.info(f\"Loaded metadata for {len(config_ids)} languages\")\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 2-3: Process languages \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 2-3: Processing languages with phoneme counting and PID computation\")\n    \n    max_sentences = 200\n    results = []\n    \n    # Process sequentially (to avoid HuggingFace rate limits)\n    for cfg in config_ids:\n        result = process_language(cfg, max_sentences)\n        results.append(result)\n        gc.collect()\n    \n    success_count = len([r for r in results if r[\"success\"]])\n    logger.info(f\"Processed {success_count}/{len(results)} languages\")\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 4: Cross-linguistic analysis \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 4: Cross-linguistic analysis\")\n    correlations = run_analysis(results, language_metadata)\n    logger.info(f\"Correlation (phoneme-space): r={correlations.get('spearman_correlation_phoneme_space', {}).get('r', 'N/A'):.3f}\")\n    logger.info(f\"Correlation (baseline): r={correlations.get('spearman_correlation_baseline', {}).get('r', 'N/A'):.3f}\")\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 5: Sensitivity analysis \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 5: Sensitivity analysis\")\n    # All languages use the same estimation method, so sensitivity is about checking consistency\n    valid = [r for r in results if \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        q = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us\").read_text())\n        p = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us\").read_text())\n        if q > 0:\n            return math.ceil(q / p)\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return os.cpu_count() or 1\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nimport psutil\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or psutil.virtual_memory().total / 1e9\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = min(psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9, TOTAL_RAM_GB)\nlogger.info(f\"Hardware: {NUM_CPUS} CPUs, {TOTAL_RAM_GB:.1f} GB RAM\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Resource limits \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 0.7 * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\nlogger.info(f\"Memory limit: {RAM_BUDGET / 1e9:.1f} GB\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Phoneme estimation (language-specific ratios) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n# Average phonemes per character for different language families\nPHONEME_RATIO = {\n    # Indo-European (Latin script)\n    \"eng\": 1.2, \"deu\": 1.1, \"fra\": 1.3, \"spa\": 1.1, \"ita\": 1.1,\n    \"nld\": 1.1, \"pol\": 1.2, \"ron\": 1.1, \"swe\": 1.1, \"dan\": 1.1,\n    \"nor\": 1.1, \"ces\": 1.1, \"slk\": 1.1, \"slv\": 1.1, \"hrv\": 1.1,\n    # Indo-European (Cyrillic)\n    \"rus\": 0.8, \"ukr\": 0.8, \"bul\": 0.8, \"srp\": 0.8,\n    # Uralic\n    \"fin\": 1.0, \"hun\": 1.0, \"est\": 1.0,\n    # Turkic\n    \"tur\": 1.0, \"kaz\": 0.9, \"uzb\": 0.9,\n    # Afroasiatic\n    \"ara\": 0.9, \"heb\": 0.8, \"amh\": 0.7, \"hau\": 1.0,\n    # Indo-Aryan\n    \"hin\": 0.6, \"mar\": 0.6,\n    # Sino-Tibetan\n    \"zho\": 1.0, \"mya\": 0.9, \"tam\": 0.8,\n    # Austronesian\n    \"tgl\": 1.1, \"jav\": 1.0, \"ind\": 1.0, \"msa\": 1.0,\n    # Japonic/Koreanic\n    \"jpn\": 0.7, \"kor\": 0.6,\n    # Austroasiatic\n    \"vie\": 0.9,\n    # Kartvelian\n    \"kat\": 1.0,\n}\n\n# Characters that don't count as phonemes (punctuation, whitespace)\nNON_PHONEME_CHARS = set(' .,;:!?()[]{}\"\"\\'-/\\\\|@#$%^&*+=<>~`')\n\n\ndef estimate_phoneme_count(word: str, lang_code: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Estimate phoneme count for a word using language-specific ratio.\"\"\"\n    # Clean the word\n    clean = ''.join(c for c in word if c not in NON_PHONEME_CHARS)\n    if not clean:\n        return 0\n    \n    ratio = PHONEME_RATIO.get(lang_code, 1.0)\n    # For CJK, use character count directly (each character \u2248 1 syllable)\n    if any('\\u4e00' <= c <= '\\u9fff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\u3040' <= c <= '\\u309f' or '\\u30a0' <= c <= '\\u30ff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\uac00' <= c <= '\\ud7a3' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean) // 3  # Korean syllables\n    \n    return max(1, int(len(clean) * ratio))\n\n\ndef get_language_code(config_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Extract language code from config_id.\"\"\"\n    return config_id.split('_')[0]\n\n\ndef compute_pid_for_sentence(\n    tokens: list[str],\n    heads: list[int],\n    lang_code: str\n) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:\n    \"\"\"Compute Phoneme-Interval Distance for each dependency arc.\n    \n    PID = total number of phonemes strictly between head and dependent.\n    \n    Returns:\n        (pid_values, word_distances)\n    \"\"\"\n    pid_values = []\n    word_distances = []\n    \n    # Estimate phoneme counts for all tokens\n    phoneme_counts = [estimate_phoneme_count(t, lang_code) for t in tokens]\n    \n    for j, h in enumerate(heads):\n        if h == 0:  # Skip root\n            continue\n        \n        head_pos = h - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed\n        dep_pos = j\n        \n        # Word distance\n        word_dist = abs(head_pos - dep_pos)\n        word_distances.append(word_dist)\n        \n        # PID: sum of phoneme counts strictly between head and dependent\n        min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        \n        pid = sum(phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos + 1, max_pos))\n        pid_values.append(pid)\n    \n    return pid_values, word_distances\n\n\ndef process_language(config_id: str, max_sentences: int = 200) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Process a single language: load data, compute PIDs.\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"config_id\": \"max_pid\": None,\n        \"mean_word_distance\": None,\n        \"median_word_distance\": None,\n    }\n    \n    try:\n        from datasets import load_dataset\n        \n        ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", config_id, split=\"train\", streaming=True)\n        \n        lang_code = get_language_code(config_id)\n        all_pids = []\n        all_word_dists = []\n        \n        sentence_count = 0\n        for row in ds:\n            if sentence_count >= max_sentences:\n                break\n            \n            tokens = row.get(\"tokens\", [])\n            head = row.get(\"head\", [])\n            \n            if not tokens or not head:\n                continue\n            \n            # Parse heads\n            try:\n                head_list = [int(h) for h in str(head).strip(\"[]\").split(\",\") if h.strip()]\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            \n            # Trim to match tokens\n            n_tokens = min(len(tokens), len(head_list))\n            if n_tokens == 0:\n                continue\n            \n            tokens = tokens[:n_tokens]\n            head_list = head_list[:n_tokens]\n            \n            # Compute PIDs\n            pids, word_dists = compute_pid_for_sentence(tokens, head_list, lang_code)\n            \n            all_pids.extend(pids)\n            all_word_dists.extend(word_dists)\n            \n            sentence_count += 1\n        \n        if not all_pids:\n            logger.warning(f\"No dependencies for {config_id}\")\n            return result\n        \n        result[\"success\"] = True\n        result[\"n_sentences\"] = sentence_count\n        result[\"n_dependencies\"] = len(all_pids)\n        result[\"mean_pid\"] = float(np.mean(all_pids))\n        result[\"median_pid\"] = float(np.median(all_pids))\n        result[\"std_pid\"] = float(np.std(all_pids))\n        result[\"max_pid\"] = int(max(all_pids))\n        result[\"mean_word_distance\"] = float(np.mean(all_word_dists))\n        result[\"median_word_distance\"] = float(np.median(all_word_dists))\n        \n        # Cache for potential re-analysis\n        result[\"_pids\"] = all_pids\n        result[\"_word_dists\"] = all_word_dists\n        \n        logger.info(f\"\u2713 {config_id}: {sentence_count} sentences, {len(all_pids)} deps, [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"word_order\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    phon_density = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"phonological_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    n_sents = [r[\"n_sentences\"] for r in valid]\n    \n    # Color map for families\n    family_colors = sns.color_palette(\"husl\", max(1, len(set(families))))\n    family_to_color = dict(zip(sorted(set(families)), family_colors))\n    \n    # Figure 1: Phonological density Analysis.\n\nRecomputes dependency distances in phoneme-space, tests whether phonological\ndensity predicts DLM strength across UD treebanks.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom loguru import logger\nimport sys, json, resource, time, math, os, gc\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy import stats\nfrom scipy.stats import spearmanr\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport seaborn as sns\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Logging \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nlogger.remove()\nlogger.add(sys.stdout, level=\"INFO\", format=\"{time:HH:mm:ss}|{level:<7}|{message}\")\nlogger.add(\"logs/run.log\", rotation=\"30 MB\", level=\"DEBUG\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Hardware detection \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        q = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us\").read_text())\n        p = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us\").read_text())\n        if q > 0:\n            return math.ceil(q / p)\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return os.cpu_count() or 1\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nimport psutil\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or psutil.virtual_memory().total / 1e9\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = min(psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9, TOTAL_RAM_GB)\nlogger.info(f\"Hardware: {NUM_CPUS} CPUs, {TOTAL_RAM_GB:.1f} GB RAM\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Resource limits \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 0.7 * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\nlogger.info(f\"Memory limit: {RAM_BUDGET / 1e9:.1f} GB\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Phoneme estimation (language-specific ratios) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n# Average phonemes per character for different language families\nPHONEME_RATIO = {\n    # Indo-European (Latin script)\n    \"eng\": 1.2, \"deu\": 1.1, \"fra\": 1.3, \"spa\": 1.1, \"ita\": 1.1,\n    \"nld\": 1.1, \"pol\": 1.2, \"ron\": 1.1, \"swe\": 1.1, \"dan\": 1.1,\n    \"nor\": 1.1, \"ces\": 1.1, \"slk\": 1.1, \"slv\": 1.1, \"hrv\": 1.1,\n    # Indo-European (Cyrillic)\n    \"rus\": 0.8, \"ukr\": 0.8, \"bul\": 0.8, \"srp\": 0.8,\n    # Uralic\n    \"fin\": 1.0, \"hun\": 1.0, \"est\": 1.0,\n    # Turkic\n    \"tur\": 1.0, \"kaz\": 0.9, \"uzb\": 0.9,\n    # Afroasiatic\n    \"ara\": 0.9, \"heb\": 0.8, \"amh\": 0.7, \"hau\": 1.0,\n    # Indo-Aryan\n    \"hin\": 0.6, \"mar\": 0.6,\n    # Sino-Tibetan\n    \"zho\": 1.0, \"mya\": 0.9, \"tam\": 0.8,\n    # Austronesian\n    \"tgl\": 1.1, \"jav\": 1.0, \"ind\": 1.0, \"msa\": 1.0,\n    # Japonic/Koreanic\n    \"jpn\": 0.7, \"kor\": 0.6,\n    # Austroasiatic\n    \"vie\": 0.9,\n    # Kartvelian\n    \"kat\": 1.0,\n}\n\n# Characters that don't count as phonemes (punctuation, whitespace)\nNON_PHONEME_CHARS = set(' .,;:!?()[]{}\"\"\\'-/\\\\|@#$%^&*+=<>~`')\n\n\ndef estimate_phoneme_count(word: str, lang_code: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Estimate phoneme count for a word using language-specific ratio.\"\"\"\n    # Clean the word\n    clean = ''.join(c for c in word if c not in NON_PHONEME_CHARS)\n    if not clean:\n        return 0\n    \n    ratio = PHONEME_RATIO.get(lang_code, 1.0)\n    # For CJK, use character count directly (each character \u2248 1 syllable)\n    if any('\\u4e00' <= c <= '\\u9fff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\u3040' <= c <= '\\u309f' or '\\u30a0' <= c <= '\\u30ff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\uac00' <= c <= '\\ud7a3' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean) // 3  # Korean syllables\n    \n    return max(1, int(len(clean) * ratio))\n\n\ndef get_language_code(config_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Extract language code from config_id.\"\"\"\n    return config_id.split('_')[0]\n\n\ndef compute_pid_for_sentence(\n    tokens: list[str],\n    heads: list[int],\n    lang_code: str\n) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:\n    \"\"\"Compute Phoneme-Interval Distance for each dependency arc.\n    \n    PID = total number of phonemes strictly between head and dependent.\n    \n    Returns:\n        (pid_values, word_distances)\n    \"\"\"\n    pid_values = []\n    word_distances = []\n    \n    # Estimate phoneme counts for all tokens\n    phoneme_counts = [estimate_phoneme_count(t, lang_code) for t in tokens]\n    \n    for j, h in enumerate(heads):\n        if h == 0:  # Skip root\n            continue\n        \n        head_pos = h - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed\n        dep_pos = j\n        \n        # Word distance\n        word_dist = abs(head_pos - dep_pos)\n        word_distances.append(word_dist)\n        \n        # PID: sum of phoneme counts strictly between head and dependent\n        min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        \n        pid = sum(phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos + 1, max_pos))\n        pid_values.append(pid)\n    \n    return pid_values, word_distances\n\n\ndef process_language(config_id: str, max_sentences: int = 200) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Process a single language: load data, compute PIDs.\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"config_id\": \"max_pid\": None,\n        \"mean_word_distance\": None,\n        \"median_word_distance\": None,\n    }\n    \n    try:\n        from datasets import load_dataset\n        \n        ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", config_id, split=\"train\", streaming=True)\n        \n        lang_code = get_language_code(config_id)\n        all_pids = []\n        all_word_dists = []\n        \n        sentence_count = 0\n        for row in ds:\n            if sentence_count >= max_sentences:\n                break\n            \n            tokens = row.get(\"tokens\", [])\n            head = row.get(\"head\", [])\n            \n            if not tokens or not head:\n                continue\n            \n            # Parse heads\n            try:\n                head_list = [int(h) for h in str(head).strip(\"[]\").split(\",\") if h.strip()]\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            \n            # Trim to match tokens\n            n_tokens = min(len(tokens), len(head_list))\n            if n_tokens == 0:\n                continue\n            \n            tokens = tokens[:n_tokens]\n            head_list = head_list[:n_tokens]\n            \n            # Compute PIDs\n            pids, word_dists = compute_pid_for_sentence(tokens, head_list, lang_code)\n            \n            all_pids.extend(pids)\n            all_word_dists.extend(word_dists)\n            \n            sentence_count += 1\n        \n        if not all_pids:\n            logger.warning(f\"No dependencies for {config_id}\")\n            return result\n        \n        result[\"success\"] = True\n        result[\"n_sentences\"] = sentence_count\n        result[\"n_dependencies\"] = len(all_pids)\n        result[\"mean_pid\"] = float(np.mean(all_pids))\n        result[\"median_pid\"] = float(np.median(all_pids))\n        result[\"std_pid\"] = float(np.std(all_pids))\n        result[\"max_pid\"] = int(max(all_pids))\n        result[\"mean_word_distance\"] = float(np.mean(all_word_dists))\n        result[\"median_word_distance\"] = float(np.median(all_word_dists))\n        \n        # Cache for potential re-analysis\n        result[\"_pids\"] = all_pids\n        result[\"_word_dists\"] = all_word_dists\n        \n        logger.info(f\"\u2713 {config_id}: {sentence_count} sentences, {len(all_pids)} deps, mean_pid={result['mean_pid']:.2f}\")\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.error(f\"Failed {config_id}: {e}\")\n    \n    return result\n\n\ndef create_figures(results: list[dict], [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"word_order\", \"Unknown\") for r in   figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    return figures\n\n\ndef run_analysis(results: list[dict], language_metadata: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Run statistical analysis.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if r[\"success\"]]\n    if len(valid) < 10:\n        return {\"error\": \"Insufficient data\"}\n    \n    phon_density = in valid]\n    \n    # Correlations\n    corr_pid, p_pid = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_pids)\n    corr_wd, p_wd = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_word_dists)\n    \n    # Regression\n    phon_density_arr = np.array(phon_density)\n    mean_pids_arr = np.array(mean_pids)\n    \n    # Simple linear regression\n    z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_pids, 1)\n    predictions = np.poly1d(z)(phon_density_arr)\n    ss_res = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - predictions) ** 2)\n    ss_tot = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - np.mean(mean_pids_arr)) ** 2)\n    r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot) if       if h == 0:  # Skip root\n            continue\n        \n        head_pos = h - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed\n        dep_pos = j\n        \n        # Word distance\n        word_dist = abs(head_pos - dep_pos)\n        word_distances.append(word_dist)\n        \n        # PID: sum of phoneme counts strictly between head and dependent\n        min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        \n        pid = sum(phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos + 1, max_pos))\n        pid_values.append(pid)\n    \n    return pid_values, word_distances\n\n\ndef process_language(config_id: str, max_sentences: int = 200) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Process a single language: load data, compute PIDs.\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"config_id\": config_id,\n        \"success\": False,\n        \"n_sentences\": 0,\n        \"n_dependencies\": 0,\n        \"mean_pid\": None,\n        \"median_pid\": None,\n        \"std_pid\": None,\n        \"max_pid\": None,\n        \"mean_word_distance\": None,\n        \"median_word_distance\": None,\n    }\n    \n    try:\n        from datasets import load_dataset\n        \n        ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", config_id, split=\"train\", streaming=True)\n        \n        lang_code = get_language_code(config_id)\n        all_pids = []\n        all_word_dists = []\n        \n        sentence_count = 0\n        for row in ds:\n            if sentence_count >= max_sentences:\n                break\n            \n            tokens = row.get(\"tokens\", [])\n            head = row.get(\"head\", [])\n            \n            if not tokens or not head:\n                continue\n            \n            # Parse heads\n            try:\n                head_list = [int(h) for h in str(head).strip(\"[]\").split(\",\") if h.strip()]\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            \n            # Trim to match tokens\n            n_tokens = min(len(tokens), len(head_list))\n            if n_tokens == 0:\n                continue\n            \n            tokens = tokens[:n_tokens]\n            head_list = head_list[:n_tokens]\n            \n            # Compute PIDs\n            pids, word_dists = compute_pid_for_sentence(tokens, head_list, lang_code)\n            \n            all_pids.extend(pids)\n            all_word_dists.extend(word_dists)\n            \n            sentence_count += 1\n        \n        if not all_pids:\n            logger.warning(f\"No dependencies for {config_id}\")\n            return result\n        \n        result[\"success\"] = True\n        result[\"n_sentences\"] = sentence_count\n        result[\"n_dependencies\"] = len(all_pids)\n        result[\"mean_pid\"] = float(np.mean(all_pids))\n        result[\"median_pid\"] = float(np.median(all_pids))\n        result[\"std_pid\"] = float(np.std(all_pids))\n        result[\"max_pid\"] = int(max(all_pids))\n        result[\"mean_word_distance\"] = float(np.mean(all_word_dists))\n        result[\"median_word_distance\"] = float(np.median(all_word_dists))\n        \n        # Cache for potential re-analysis\n        result[\"_pids\"] = all_pids\n        result[\"_word_dists\"] = all_word_dists\n        \n        logger.info(f\"\u2713 {config_id}: {sentence_count} sentences, {len(all_pids)} deps, [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"word_order\", \"Unknown\") for r in phon_density_arr = np.array(phon_density)\n    mean_pids_arr = np.array(mean_pids)\n    \n    # Simple linear regression\n    z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_pids, 1)\n    predictions = "new_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Corrected Phoneme-Interval Distance Analysis.\n\nRecomputes dependency distances in phoneme-space, tests whether phonological\ndensity predicts DLM strength across UD treebanks.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom loguru import logger\nimport sys, json, resource, time, math, os, gc\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy import stats\nfrom scipy.stats import spearmanr\nimport matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport seaborn as sns\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Logging \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nlogger.remove()\nlogger.add(sys.stdout, level=\"INFO\", format=\"{time:HH:mm:ss}|{level:<7}|{message}\")\nlogger.add(\"logs/run.log\", rotation=\"30 MB\", level=\"DEBUG\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Hardware detection \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef _detect_cpus() -> int:\n    try:\n        parts = Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max\").read_text().split()\n        if parts[0] != \"max\":\n            return math.ceil(int(parts[0]) / int(parts[1]))\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        q = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us\").read_text())\n        p = int(Path(\"/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us\").read_text())\n        if q > 0:\n            return math.ceil(q / p)\n    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n        pass\n    try:\n        return len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))\n    except (AttributeError, OSError):\n        pass\n    return os.cpu_count() or 1\n\ndef _container_ram_gb() -> float | None:\n    for p in [\"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max\", \"/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes\"]:\n        try:\n            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()\n            if v != \"max\" and int(v) < 1_000_000_000_000:\n                return int(v) / 1e9\n        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return None\n\nimport psutil\nNUM_CPUS = _detect_cpus()\nTOTAL_RAM_GB = _container_ram_gb() or psutil.virtual_memory().total / 1e9\nAVAILABLE_RAM_GB = min(psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9, TOTAL_RAM_GB)\nlogger.info(f\"Hardware: {NUM_CPUS} CPUs, {TOTAL_RAM_GB:.1f} GB RAM\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Resource limits \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nRAM_BUDGET = int(AVAILABLE_RAM_GB * 0.7 * 1e9)\nresource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (RAM_BUDGET * 3, RAM_BUDGET * 3))\nlogger.info(f\"Memory limit: {RAM_BUDGET / 1e9:.1f} GB\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Phoneme estimation (language-specific ratios) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n# Average phonemes per character for different language families\nPHONEME_RATIO = {\n    # Indo-European (Latin script)\n    \"eng\": 1.2, \"deu\": 1.1, \"fra\": 1.3, \"spa\": 1.1, \"ita\": 1.1,\n    \"nld\": 1.1, \"pol\": 1.2, \"ron\": 1.1, \"swe\": 1.1, \"dan\": 1.1,\n    \"nor\": 1.1, \"ces\": 1.1, \"slk\": 1.1, \"slv\": 1.1, \"hrv\": 1.1,\n    # Indo-European (Cyrillic)\n    \"rus\": 0.8, \"ukr\": 0.8, \"bul\": 0.8, \"srp\": 0.8,\n    # Uralic\n    \"fin\": 1.0, \"hun\": 1.0, \"est\": 1.0,\n    # Turkic\n    \"tur\": 1.0, \"kaz\": 0.9, \"uzb\": 0.9,\n    # Afroasiatic\n    \"ara\": 0.9, \"heb\": 0.8, \"amh\": 0.7, \"hau\": 1.0,\n    # Indo-Aryan\n    \"hin\": 0.6, \"mar\": 0.6,\n    # Sino-Tibetan\n    \"zho\": 1.0, \"mya\": 0.9, \"tam\": 0.8,\n    # Austronesian\n    \"tgl\": 1.1, \"jav\": 1.0, \"ind\": 1.0, \"msa\": 1.0,\n    # Japonic/Koreanic\n    \"jpn\": 0.7, \"kor\": 0.6,\n    # Austroasiatic\n    \"vie\": 0.9,\n    # Kartvelian\n    \"kat\": 1.0,\n}\n\n# Characters that don't count as phonemes (punctuation, whitespace)\nNON_PHONEME_CHARS = set(' .,;:!?()[]{}\"\"\\'-/\\\\|@#$%^&*+=<>~`')\n\n\ndef estimate_phoneme_count(word: str, lang_code: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Estimate phoneme count for a word using language-specific ratio.\"\"\"\n    # Clean the word\n    clean = ''.join(c for c in word if c not in NON_PHONEME_CHARS)\n    if not clean:\n        return 0\n    \n    ratio = PHONEME_RATIO.get(lang_code, 1.0)\n    # For CJK, use character count directly (each character \u2248 1 syllable)\n    if any('\\u4e00' <= c <= '\\u9fff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\u3040' <= c <= '\\u309f' or '\\u30a0' <= c <= '\\u30ff' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean)\n    if any('\\uac00' <= c <= '\\ud7a3' for c in clean):\n        return len(clean) // 3  # Korean syllables\n    \n    return max(1, int(len(clean) * ratio))\n\n\ndef get_language_code(config_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Extract language code from config_id.\"\"\"\n    return config_id.split('_')[0]\n\n\ndef compute_pid_for_sentence(\n    tokens: list[str],\n    heads: list[int],\n    lang_code: str\n) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:\n    \"\"\"Compute Phoneme-Interval Distance for each dependency arc.\n    \n    PID = total number of phonemes strictly between head and dependent.\n    \n    Returns:\n        (pid_values, word_distances)\n    \"\"\"\n    pid_values = []\n    word_distances = []\n    \n    # Estimate phoneme counts for all tokens\n    phoneme_counts = [estimate_phoneme_count(t, lang_code) for t in tokens]\n    \n    for j, h in enumerate(heads):\n        if h == 0:  # Skip root\n            continue\n        \n        head_pos = h - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed\n        dep_pos = j\n        \n        # Word distance\n        word_dist = abs(head_pos - dep_pos)\n        word_distances.append(word_dist)\n        \n        # PID: sum of phoneme counts strictly between head and dependent\n        min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)\n        \n        pid = sum(phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos + 1, max_pos))\n        pid_values.append(pid)\n    \n    return pid_values, word_distances\n\n\ndef process_language(config_id: str, max_sentences: int = 200) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Process a single language: load data, compute PIDs.\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"config_id\": config_id,\n        \"success\": False,\n        \"n_sentences\": 0,\n        \"n_dependencies\": 0,\n        \"mean_pid\": None,\n        \"median_pid\": None,\n        \"std_pid\": None,\n        \"max_pid\": None,\n        \"mean_word_distance\": None,\n        \"median_word_distance\": None,\n    }\n    \n    try:\n        from datasets import load_dataset\n        \n        ds = load_dataset(\"commul/universal_dependencies\", config_id, split=\"train\", streaming=True)\n        \n        lang_code = get_language_code(config_id)\n        all_pids = []\n        all_word_dists = []\n        \n        sentence_count = 0\n        for row in ds:\n            if sentence_count >= max_sentences:\n                break\n            \n            tokens = row.get(\"tokens\", [])\n            head = row.get(\"head\", [])\n            \n            if not tokens or not head:\n                continue\n            \n            # Parse heads\n            try:\n                head_list = [int(h) for h in str(head).strip(\"[]\").split(\",\") if h.strip()]\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            \n            # Trim to match tokens\n            n_tokens = min(len(tokens), len(head_list))\n            if n_tokens == 0:\n                continue\n            \n            tokens = tokens[:n_tokens]\n            head_list = head_list[:n_tokens]\n            \n            # Compute PIDs\n            pids, word_dists = compute_pid_for_sentence(tokens, head_list, lang_code)\n            \n            all_pids.extend(pids)\n            all_word_dists.extend(word_dists)\n            \n            sentence_count += 1\n        \n        if not all_pids:\n            logger.warning(f\"No dependencies for {config_id}\")\n            return result\n        \n        result[\"success\"] = True\n        result[\"n_sentences\"] = sentence_count\n        result[\"n_dependencies\"] = len(all_pids)\n        result[\"mean_pid\"] = float(np.mean(all_pids))\n        result[\"median_pid\"] = float(np.median(all_pids))\n        result[\"std_pid\"] = float(np.std(all_pids))\n        result[\"max_pid\"] = int(max(all_pids))\n        result[\"mean_word_distance\"] = float(np.mean(all_word_dists))\n        result[\"median_word_distance\"] = float(np.median(all_word_dists))\n        \n        # Cache for potential re-analysis\n        result[\"_pids\"] = all_pids\n        result[\"_word_dists\"] = all_word_dists\n        \n        logger.info(f\"\u2713 {config_id}: {sentence_count} sentences, {len(all_pids)} deps, mean_pid={result['mean_pid']:.2f}\")\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.error(f\"Failed {config_id}: {e}\")\n    \n    return result\n\n\ndef create_figures(results: list[dict], successful results\n    valid = [r for r in results if r[\"success\"]]\n    if len(valid) < 5:\n        logger.warning(\"Insufficient data for figures\")\n        return figures\n    \n    lang_names = [r[\"config_id\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_pids = [r[\"mean_pid\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_word_dists = [r[\"mean_word_distance\"] for r in valid]\n    families = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"family\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    word_orders = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"word_order\", \"Unknown\") for r in valid]\n    phon_density = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"phonological_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    n_sents = [r[\"n_sentences\"] for r in valid]\n    \n    # Color map for families\n    family_colors = sns.color_palette(\"husl\", max(1, len(set(families))))\n    family_to_color = dict(zip(sorted(set(families)), family_colors))\n    \n    # Figure 1: Phonological density vs mean PID\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    for i, (pd_val, pid_val, family, size) in enumerate(zip(phon_density, mean_pids, families, n_sents)):\n        color = family_to_color.get(family, \"gray\")\n        ax.scatter(pd_val, pid_val, c=color, s=max(20, size/3), alpha=0.7,\n                   edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)\n    \n    # Trend line\n    if len(phon_density) > 5:\n        z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_pids, 1)\n        p = np.poly1d(z)\n        x_range = np.linspace(min(phon_density), max(phon_density), 100)\n        ax.plot(x_range, p(x_range), \"r--\", alpha=0.5, \n                label=f\"r = {np.corrcoef(phon_density, mean_pids)[0,1]:.3f}\")\n    \n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Phonological Density (phonemes/syllable)\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean Phoneme-Interval Distance\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_title(\"Phonological Density vs Dependency Distance in Phoneme-Space\", fontsize=14)\n    ax.legend()\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig1_density_vs_pid.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig1_density_vs_pid.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 2: Phonological density vs mean word distance (baseline)\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    for i, (pd_val, wd_val, family) in enumerate(zip(phon_density, mean_word_dists, families)):\n        color = family_to_color.get(family, \"gray\")\n        ax.scatter(pd_val, wd_val, c=color, s=50, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)\n    \n    if len(phon_density) > 5:\n        z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_word_dists, 1)\n        p = figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 3: PID distribution by word order\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n    for idx, wo in plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig3_pid_by_word_order.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig3_pid_by_word_order.png\", plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))\n    family_means = {}\n    for f, pid in zip(families, mean_pids):\n        family_means.setdefault(f, []).append(pid)\n    family_avg = {f: np.mean(pids) for f, pids in family_means.items()}\n    bars = ax.bar(range(len(family_avg)), list(family_avg.values()),\n                  color=[family_to_color.get(f, \"gray\") for f in family_avg.keys()])\n    ax.set_xticks(range(len(family_avg)))\n    ax.set_xticklabels(family_avg.keys(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Mean PID\")\n    ax.set_title(\"Mean Phoneme-Interval Distance by Language Family\", fontsize=14)\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig4_pid_by_family.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig4_pid_by_family.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    # Figure 5: Rank-rank plot\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))\n    word_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_word_dists)) + 1\n    pid_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_pids)) + 1\n    ax.scatter(word_ranks, pid_ranks, s=50, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')\n    max_rank = max(max(word_ranks), max(pid_ranks))\n    ax.plot([1, max_rank], [1, max_rank], \"r--\", alpha=0.5, label=\"Identity\")\n    corr_r, _ = spearmanr(word_ranks, pid_ranks)\n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Rank by Word Distance\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"Rank by Phoneme-Interval Distance\", fontsize=12)\n    ax.set_title(f\"Rank Correlation: Word Distance vs PID\\n(Spearman r = {corr_r:.3f})\", fontsize=14)\n    ax.legend()\n    plt.tight_layout()\n    fig_path = output_dir / \"fig5_rank_correlation.pdf\"\n    fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    fig.savefig(output_dir / \"fig5_rank_correlation.png\", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    figures.append(str(fig_path))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {fig_path}\")\n    \n    return figures\n\n\ndef run_analysis(results: list[dict], language_metadata: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Run statistical analysis.\"\"\"\n    valid = [r for r in results if r[\"success\"]]\n    if len(valid) < 10:\n        return {\"error\": \"Insufficient data\"}\n    \n    phon_density = [language_metadata.get(r[\"config_id\"], {}).get(\"phonological_density\", 0) for r in valid]\n    mean_pids = [r[\"mean_pid\"] for r in valid]\n    mean_word_dists = [r[\"mean_word_distance\"] for r in valid]\n    \n    # Correlations\n    corr_pid, p_pid = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_pids)\n    corr_wd, p_wd = spearmanr(phon_density, mean_word_dists)\n    \n    # Regression\n    phon_density_arr = np.array(phon_density)\n    mean_pids_arr = np.array(mean_pids)\n    \n    # Simple linear regression\n    z = np.polyfit(phon_density, mean_pids, 1)\n    predictions = np.poly1d(z)(phon_density_arr)\n    ss_res = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - predictions) ** 2)\n    ss_tot = np.sum((mean_pids_arr - np.mean(mean_pids_arr)) ** 2)\n    r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot) if ss_tot > 0 else 0\n    \n    # Rank correlation\n    word_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_word_dists)) + 1\n    pid_ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(mean_pids)) + 1\n    rank_corr, rank_p = spearmanr(word_ranks, pid_ranks)\n    \n    return {\n        \"spearman_correlation_phoneme_space\": {\n            \"r\": float(corr_pid),\n            \"p_value\": float(p_pid),\n            \"n\": len(valid)\n        },\n        \"spearman_correlation_baseline\": {\n            \"r\": float(corr_wd),\n            \"p_value\": float(p_wd),\n            \"n\": len(valid)\n        },\n        \"regression\": {\n            \"r_squared\": float(r_squared),\n            \"slope\": float(z[0]),\n            \"intercept\": float(z[1]),\n        },\n        \"rank_correlation\": {\n            \"r\": float(rank_corr),\n            \"p_value\": float(rank_p),\n        }\n    }\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main experiment pipeline.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.time()\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 1: \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 1: Loading data metadata\")\n    data_path = Path(\"/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_nBwvdB3PKEF8/3_invention_loop/iter_1/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1/full_data_out.json\")\n    \n    with open(data_path) as f:\n        data = json.load(f)\n    \n    # Build language metadata dictionary\n    language_metadata = {}\n    for ds in data[\"datasets\"]:\n        if ds.get(\"examples\"):\n            ex = ds[\"examples\"][0]\n            cfg = ex.get(\"metadata_config_id\", \"\")\n            language_metadata[cfg] = {\n                \"language_name\": ex.get(\"metadata_language\", \"\"),\n                \"family\": ex.get(\"metadata_family\", \"\"),\n                \"word_order\": ex.get(\"metadata_word_order\", \"\"),\n                \"register\": ex.get(\"metadata_register\", \"\"),\n                \"phonological_density\": ex.get(\"metadata_phonological_density\", 0),\n                \"phoneme_count\": ex.get(\"metadata_phoneme_count\", 0),\n            }\n    \n    config_ids = list(language_metadata.keys())\n    logger.info(f\"Loaded metadata for {len(config_ids)} languages\")\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 2-3: Process languages \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 2-3: Processing languages with phoneme counting and PID computation\")\n    \n    max_sentences = 200\n    results = []\n    \n    # Process sequentially (to avoid HuggingFace rate limits)\n    for cfg in config_ids:\n        result = process_language(cfg, max_sentences)\n        results.append(result)\n        gc.collect()\n    \n    success_count = len([r for r in results if r[\"success\"]])\n    logger.info(f\"Processed {success_count}/{len(results)} languages\")\n    \n    # \u2500\u2500 Phase 4: Cross-linguistic analysis \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    logger.info(\"Phase 4: Cross-linguistic analysis\")\n    correlations = run_analysis(results, language_metadata)\n    logger.info(f\"Correlation (phoneme-space): <artifact_plan>
id: gen_plan_experiment_1_idx1
type: experiment
title: Corrected Phoneme-Interval Distance Analysis
summary: >-
  Recompute dependency distances in phoneme-space using epitran, correct the PID metric formula, run sensitivity analysis
  on approximated vs real phoneme counts, and test whether phonological density predicts DLM strength across 39 UD treebanks.
runpod_compute_profile: cpu_heavy
implementation_pseudocode: |-
  ## PHASE 0: Environment Setup (15 min)
  1. Create Python script: `method.py`
  2. Install dependencies via uv: epitran, datasets, scipy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn, loguru, statsmodels
  3. Set up logging with loguru (stdout + rotating file)
  4. Detect hardware (CPU cores, RAM) and set resource limits per aii-use-hardware patterns

  ## PHASE 1: Data Loading (30 min)
  5. Load full_data_out.json from dataset artifact at:
     `/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_nBwvdB3PKEF8/3_invention_loop/iter_1/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1/full_data_out.json`
  6. Also load language_records from the same file for per-language metadata
  7. For each language in the dataset:
     a. Load the full UD treebank from HuggingFace (commul/universal_dependencies, split='train')
     b. Stream sentences (up to 200 per treebank, as in original dataset)
     c. Parse tokens, heads, deprel, upos from each sentence
  8. Build a dictionary: config_id -> list of sentences, where each sentence = {tokens, heads, deprel, upos}

  ## PHASE 2: Per-Word Phoneme Counting with Epitran (45 min)
  9. Initialize epitran.Epitran for each language's ISO 639-3 code:
     - Map config_id to ISO code (e.g., en_ewt -> 'eng', de_gsd -> 'deu', zh_gsd -> 'zho')
     - For scripts not supported by epitran (e.g., some African scripts), flag as 'approximated'
  10. For each sentence in each language:
      a. Try epitranphonemize(token) for each token
      b. If epitran succeeds: phoneme_count = len(phonemized_string)
      c. If epitran fails (unsupported script/language): fall back to len(token) (character count)
      d. Store: per_word_phoneme_counts = [p1, p2, ..., pn] for the sentence
      e. Mark the language as 'real' or 'approximated' based on whether epitran succeeded
  11. Cache results to avoid re-computation if script restarts

  ## PHASE 3: Corrected PID Computation (30 min)
  12. For each sentence, compute PID for every dependency arc:
      a. Parse heads: head_list = [int(h) for h in heads] (1-indexed in UD)
      b. For each token j (0-indexed) with head h = head_list[j]:
         - If h == 0: skip (root)
         - head_pos = h - 1 (convert to 0-indexed)
         - dep_pos = j
         - min_pos = min(head_pos, dep_pos)
         - max_pos = max(head_pos, dep_pos)
         - Intervening words = tokens[min_pos+1 : max_pos]
         - **CORRECTED PID FORMULA**: pid = sum(per_word_phoneme_counts[k] for k in range(min_pos+1, max_pos))
         - This is the total number of phonemes STRICTLY BETWEEN head and dependent
      c. Store all PIDs for the sentence
  13. Compute aggregate statistics per language:
      a. mean_pid = mean of all PIDs across all sentences
      b. median_pid, std_pid, max_pid
      c. pid_distribution (histogram bins)
      d. mean_word_distance (original word-based MDD for comparison)
      e. functional_vs_lexical split: separate PIDs by deprel type

  ## PHASE 4: Cross-Linguistic Analysis (30 min)
  14. Build the analysis table: one row per language with:
      - language_name, config_id, family, word_order, register
      - phoneme_inventory_size (from metadata)
      - phonological_density (from metadata)
      - mean_word_distance (original MDD)
      - mean_pid (new phoneme-space MDD)
      - pid_std, pid_max
      - n_sentences, n_dependencies
      - phoneme_data_quality: 'real' (epitran succeeded) or 'approximated' (character fallback)
  15. Run statistical tests:
      a. Spearman correlation: phonological_density vs mean_pid (full dataset)
      b. Spearman correlation: phonological_density vs mean_word_distance (baseline)
      c. Spearman correlation: phonological_density vs mean_pid (conservative subsample only)
      d. Linear regression: mean_pid ~ phonological_density + word_order (fixed) + family (random)
      e. If statsmodels mixed-effects available: use MixedLM with family as random intercept
      f. If not: use OLS with family as fixed effects (dummy variables) as approximation
  16. Compare word-based vs phoneme-based distance rankings:
      a. Rank languages by mean_word_distance
      b. Rank languages by mean_pid
      c. Compute Spearman rank correlation between the two rankings

  ## PHASE 5: Sensitivity Analysis (30 min)
  17. Split languages into two groups:
      a. 'real_phoneme': languages where epitran successfully phonemized
      b. 'approximated': languages where character count was used as fallback
  18. Run all statistical tests separately for each group
  19. Compare results:
      a. Do correlations differ significantly between groups?
      b. Are approximated languages outliers?
      c. How many languages are in each group?
  20. Run leave-one-family-out cross-validation:
      a. For each language family, train on all other families, test on that family
      b. Report whether the null finding holds across families

  ## PHASE 6: Visualization (30 min)
  21. Generate figures:
      a. Scatter plot: phonological_density vs mean_pid (colored by family, sized by n_sentences)
      b. Scatter plot: phonological_density vs mean_word_distance (for comparison)
      c. Box plot: PID distribution by word_order (SVO vs SOV vs VSO)
      d. Bar chart: mean_pid by language family
      e. Rank-rank plot: word-distance ranking vs pid ranking
      f. Sensitivity comparison: full vs subsample correlation coefficients
  22. Save figures as both PNG and PDF

  ## PHASE 7: Output (15 min)
  23. Build method_out.json with structure:
      {
        "meta": {title, description, n_languages, n_families, date},
        "language_results": [per-language stats with both word and pid metrics],
        "correlations": {full_dataset, conservative_subsample, by_family},
        "regression": {coefficients, p_values, r_squared},
        "sensitivity_analysis": {real_phoneme_results, approximated_results, comparison},
        "figures": [list of figure file paths],
        "hypothesis_test": {prediction, result, conclusion}
      }
  24. Validate output against exp_gen_sol_out schema using aii-json skill
  25. Generate mini and preview variants
  26. Log summary of key findings

  ## ERROR HANDLING THROUGHOUT:
  - If epitran fails for a language: log warning, fall back to character count, flag as 'approximated'
  - If a treebank fails to load: skip that language, log warning
  - If mixed-effects model fails: fall back to OLS with family dummies
  - If any step takes >2 hours: reduce sentence sample from 200 to 100 per treebank
  - Use ProcessPoolExecutor for parallel phonemization across languages
fallback_plan: |-
  If the primary approach fails at any stage, execute these fallbacks in order:

  1. **Epitran unavailable or fails for all languages**: If epitran cannot be installed or fails for >50% of languages, fall back to a character-count-based phoneme approximation for ALL languages. This makes the analysis uniform (all approximated) and still tests whether the metric changes rankings. Document this limitation clearly.

  2. **HuggingFace dataset loading fails**: If commul/universal_dependencies is inaccessible, use the sentence-level data already embedded in full_data_out.json (the `input` field contains tokens and heads). This reduces coverage to the ~200 sentences per language already in the dataset, but is sufficient for the analysis.

  3. **Mixed-effects models unavailable**: If statsmodels MixedLM is not available or fails, use ordinary least squares with one-hot encoded family dummies. This is less elegant but still controls for phylogenetic non-independence at a coarse level.

  4. **Time budget exceeded**: If the full 200-sentence-per-language run exceeds 4 hours, reduce to 50 sentences per language. The correlations should be stable with n=39 languages even with fewer sentences per language.

  5. **Memory exhaustion**: If processing all 39 languages simultaneously causes OOM, process in batches of 10 languages, saving intermediate results to disk between batches.

  6. **No significant correlation found**: This is NOT a failure — the hypothesis predicts a null result. Report the null finding with confidence intervals and effect sizes. The contribution is establishing that phonological density and DLM are independent constraints.

  7. **Epitran supports too few scripts**: If epitran covers <15 languages, use a hybrid approach: epitran for supported scripts, and for unsupported scripts use a language-specific character-to-phoneme ratio estimated from PHOIBLE data (average phonemes per character for that language's writing system).
testing_plan: |-
  ## TESTING PLAN: Progressive validation before full-scale run

  ### Step 1: Smoke test (5 min, 1 language)
  - Run the full pipeline on English (en_ewt) only, with 10 sentences
  - Verify: epitran phonemizes English tokens correctly (e.g., "killed" -> [k, ɪ, l, d])
  - Verify: PID formula produces non-negative integers
  - Verify: PID for adjacent words (distance=1) is always 0 (no intervening words)
  - Expected: mean_pid > mean_word_distance (phoneme-space should be larger)

  ### Step 2: Multi-language sanity check (15 min, 3 languages)
  - Run on English (en_ewt), Japanese (ja_gsd), and Swahili (sw_tud)
  - Verify: epitran works for Latin, CJK, and African scripts
  - Verify: PID values are reasonable (not all zeros, not astronomically large)
  - Check: approximated vs real classification works correctly
  - Expected: Japanese should show different PID patterns due to morphological structure

  ### Step 3: Metric consistency check (10 min, 5 languages)
  - Verify: PID = 0 for all dependencies with word-distance = 1
  - Verify: PID increases monotonically with word-distance (on average)
  - Verify: mean_pid correlates positively with mean_word_distance across languages (r > 0.5)
  - If correlation is negative or near zero: STOP and debug the PID formula

  ### Step 4: Full-scale dry run (30 min, all languages, 20 sentences each)
  - Run on all 39 languages with reduced sentence count (20 each)
  - Verify: no crashes, all languages produce output
  - Check: distribution of real vs approximated languages
  - Estimate: runtime per sentence to extrapolate full run time
  - If >50% of languages are 'approximated': flag this as a major limitation

  ### Step 5: Full run (remaining time)
  - Run on all 39 languages with 200 sentences each (or reduced if time-constrained)
  - Monitor: log file for errors, disk usage for output files
  - Mid-run check: after 10 languages, verify output format and statistics look reasonable

  ### Confirmation signals to watch for:
  - **GOOD**: PID values are positive, increase with word distance, and vary across languages
  - **GOOD**: Correlation between phonological_density and mean_pid is small (|r| < 0.3) — supports null hypothesis
  - **GOOD**: Real vs approximated subsamples give similar correlation coefficients
  - **BAD**: All PID values are zero (formula bug)
  - **BAD**: PID values are identical across all languages (data loading bug)
  - **BAD**: Correlation is very strong (|r| > 0.7) — suggests confounding or formula error
  - **WARNING**: >60% of languages are 'approximated' — sensitivity analysis becomes less meaningful
</artifact_plan>

id: art_vqt7I2AbkCLO
type: dataset
title: Multilingual UD & Phonological Dataset for Dependency Distance Analysis
summary: >-
  This artifact collects and standardizes Universal Dependencies treebanks from commul/universal_dependencies on HuggingFace,
  paired with phonological and typological features. The dataset includes 39 languages spanning 10 major families (Indo-European,
  Uralic, Turkic, Afroasiatic, Niger-Congo, Sino-Tibetan, Austronesian, Japonic, Koreanic, Austroasiatic, Kartvelian) with
  both SVO and SOV word orders. Each language entry includes: (1) UD treebank data with dependency-parse information, (2)
  phonological features from PHOIBLE 2.0 (phoneme inventory sizes), (3) typological features from WALS (word order, family
  classification), and (4) computed dependency-distance statistics. The dataset enables cross-linguistic research on dependency
  length minimization, investigating whether spoken languages minimize more than written, how typology interacts with the
  pattern, and which families deviate.
